title.en: Matching through a change of light

after.zh: 先让每个窗口减去自己的平均亮度，整体变亮就不影响距离了；再除以自己的标准差，连对比度变了也不怕。这就是归一化互相关（NCC）的想法，SIFT 描述子也会做类似的归一化。
after.en: Subtract each window's own mean brightness first, and an overall brightening no longer affects the distance; divide by its own standard deviation as well, and even a contrast change does not matter. This is the idea behind normalised cross-correlation (NCC), and SIFT descriptors are normalised in a similar way.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-6-4"></part-ref>接上三个距离，它给出配上的候选编号。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-6-4"></part-ref> in the tray takes three distances and returns the number of the matching candidate.

t.zh: 两张照片常常不是同时拍的，光线变了，同一处在右图里整体亮一截。
t.en: Two photos are often not taken at the same moment: the light changes, and the same place is brighter all over in the right one.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：找出哪个候选窗口和关键点的窗口是同一处，输出它的编号。
t.en: Your task in this level: find which candidate window shows the same place as the keypoint window, and output its number.

brief.zh: 右图整体亮了一截。用匹配器找出哪个候选窗口和关键点的窗口是同一处，输出它的编号。
brief.en: The right image is brighter all over. Use the matcher to find which candidate window shows the same place as the keypoint window, and output its number.

hint.zh: 距离 = 平均((窗口 − 候选)²)。整体亮了一截时，每一格都差同一个数，这一点能先去掉吗？
hint.en: Distance = average((window − candidate)²). When everything is brighter by some amount, every cell differs by the same number. Can you take that away first?
